cards.ex: We're trying to reduce our carbon footprint by flying less and eating local.
cards.exUz: Biz kamroq uchib, mahalliy mahsulotlar iste'mol qilish orqali uglerod izimizni kamaytirishga harakat qilyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Shaxs, tashkilot yoki mahsulotning atrof-muhitga ta'sirini ko'rsatuvchi karbonat angidrid miqdori.

cards.ex: More and more people are trying to go green these days.
cards.exUz: So'nggi paytlarda ko'proq odamlar yashil bo'lishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazmaslik uchun ekologik usulda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Climate change is a serious threat to our planet.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi sayyoramizga jiddiy tahdid solmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yer yuzidagi iqlim sharoitlarining uzoq muddatli o'zgarishi.

cards.ex: Investing in renewable energy is crucial for a sustainable future.
cards.exUz: Qayta tiklanuvchi energiyaga sarmoya kiritish barqaror kelajak uchun muhim.
cards.uzDef: Qayta tiklanishi mumkin bo'lgan manbalardan olinadigan energiya (quyosh, shamol va boshqalar).

cards.ex: There's a growing environmental awareness among young people.
cards.exUz: Yoshlar orasida ekologik ong o'sib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitning muhimligini tushunish va uni himoya qilishga tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: Don't forget to put the plastic bottles in the recycling bin.
cards.exUz: Plastik butilkalarni qayta ishlash qutisiga tashlashni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Qayta ishlash uchun materiallar tashlanadigan quti.

cards.ex: Global warming is causing sea levels to rise.
cards.exUz: Global isish dengiz sathining ko'tarilishiga olib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yer yuzidagi o'rtacha haroratning asta-sekin ko'tarilishi.

cards.ex: The greenhouse effect is intensified by human activity.
cards.exUz: Issiqxona effekti inson faoliyati natijasida kuchaymoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atmosferadagi gazlar tufayli Yer yuzidagi issiqlikning ushlanib qolishi.

cards.ex: We need to cut down on our energy consumption.
cards.exUz: Biz energiya iste'molini qisqartirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir miqdorini kamaytirish, kamroq ishlatish.

cards.ex: We're going to run out of clean water if we don't act now.
cards.exUz: Agar hozir harakat qilmasak, toza suvimiz tugaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning zaxirasi tugashi, yetishmay qolishi.

cards.ex: Many species are dying out due to habitat loss.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab turlar yashash muhitining yo'qolishi sababli yo'q bo'lib ketmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror turdagi o'simlik yoki hayvonning butunlay yo'q bo'lib ketishi.

cards.ex: A single disease could wipe out the entire population.
cards.exUz: Bitta kasallik butun aholini yo'q qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay yo'q qilish, qirib tashlash.

cards.ex: Clear-cutting forests destroys habitats.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarni kesib tashlash yashash joylarini yo'q qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Daraxtlarni butunlay kesib tashlash.

cards.ex: We need to assess the environmental impact of this project.
cards.exUz: Biz ushbu loyihaning ekologik ta'sirini baholashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning atrof-muhitga ta'siri.

cards.ex: Sustainable development is essential for long-term prosperity.
cards.exUz: Barqaror rivojlanish uzoq muddatli farovonlik uchun zarur.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak avlodlarning ehtiyojlarini qondirish imkoniyatini kamaytirmasdan bugungi kunning ehtiyojlarini qondirish.

cards.ex: We need to conserve our natural resources for future generations.
cards.exUz: Biz kelajak avlodlar uchun tabiiy resurslarimizni saqlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatdan olinadigan foydali materiallar (suv, o'rmon, minerallar va boshqalar).

cards.ex: Eco-friendly products are becoming more popular.
cards.exUz: Ekologik toza mahsulotlar tobora ommalashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazmaydigan yoki kam zarar yetkazadigan.

cards.ex: Everyone needs to do their bit to protect the environment.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish uchun har kim o'z hissasini qo'shishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Katta muammoni hal qilishda kichik bir qismini bajarish.

cards.ex: Pollution is taking its toll on people's health.
cards.exUz: Ifloslanish odamlarning sog'lig'iga o'z ta'sirini o'tkazmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatmoq, zarar yetkazmoq.

cards.ex: If we don't address climate change, we'll pay the price in the future.
cards.exUz: Agar biz iqlim o'zgarishiga e'tibor bermasak, kelajakda to'lov qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri xatti-harakatning salbiy oqibatlarini boshdan kechirmoq.

cards.ex: Our efforts to reduce waste are just a drop in the bucket.
cards.exUz: Chiqindilarni kamaytirish bo'yicha harakatlarimiz shunchaki tomchi suv.
cards.uzDef: Katta muammoga nisbatan juda kichik va ahamiyatsiz harakat.

cards.ex: The factory was fined for illegally dumping toxic waste.
cards.exUz: Zavod zaharli chiqindilarni noqonuniy ravishda tashlagani uchun jarimaga tortildi.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhit va sog'liq uchun xavfli bo'lgan chiqindi.

cards.ex: Many organizations are working to protect endangered species.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab tashkilotlar yo'qolib borayotgan turlarni himoya qilish uchun ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida bo'lgan o'simliklar yoki hayvonlar turlari.

cards.ex: Climate change is disrupting normal weather patterns.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi normal ob-havo naqshlarini buzmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir hududda kuzatiladigan ob-havoning tipik holati.

cards.ex: The earthquake was a devastating natural disaster.
cards.exUz: Zilzila halokatli tabiiy ofat edi.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatning katta zarar keltiruvchi hodisasi (zilzila, to'fon va boshqalar).

cards.ex: Environmental protection is everyone's responsibility.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish har bir kishining burchidir.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni ifloslanish va buzilishdan himoya qilish.

cards.ex: Remember the three R's: reduce, reuse, recycle.
cards.exUz: Uchta R ni eslang: kamaytiring, qayta foydalaning, qayta ishlang.
cards.uzDef: Chiqindilarni kamaytirish, qayta foydalanish va qayta ishlash orqali atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish.

cards.ex: The destruction of the rainforest is damaging the entire eco-system.
cards.exUz: Tropik o'rmonlarning yo'q qilinishi butun ekosistemaga zarar yetkazmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biri bilan o'zaro bog'liq bo'lgan o'simliklar, hayvonlar va mikroorganizmlar hamjamiyati.

cards.ex: Conservation efforts are vital for preserving biodiversity.
cards.exUz: Muhofaza choralari biologik xilma-xillikni saqlash uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Tabiiy resurslarni va atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilishga qaratilgan harakatlar.

cards.ex: Littering is against the law and harms the environment.
cards.exUz: Axlat tashlash qonunga zid va atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazadi.
cards.uzDef: Jamoat joylariga axlat tashlash.
